cards.front: No te preocupes por ello. No importa nada.
cards.back: Don't worry about it. It doesn't matter one bit.

cards.front: No pierdas el sueño por ello. ¡No importa nada!
cards.back: Don't lose any sleep over it. It doesn't matter one bit!

cards.front: No me importa nada lo que diga. No es el encargado.
cards.back: It doesn't matter one bit to me what he says. He's not in charge.

cards.front: No están de acuerdo, pero no importa nada. Nos encargamos nosotros.
cards.back: They don't agree but it doesn't matter in the slightest. We're in charge.

cards.front: Él no estará de acuerdo contigo, pero no importa nada.
cards.back: He won't agree with you but it doesn't matter in the slightest.

cards.front: No pierdas sueño por ello. No importa nada.
cards.back: Don't lose any sleep over it. It doesn't matter in the slightest.

cards.front: Importa mucho lo que piensas.
cards.back: It matters greatly what you think.

cards.front: Lo que piensas nos importa mucho.
cards.back: What you think matters greatly to us.

cards.front: La decisión que tomamos hoy importará mucho en el futuro.
cards.back: The decision we make today will matter greatly in the future.

cards.front: Importa poco lo que piense. Él no está a cargo.
cards.back: It matters little what he thinks. He isn't in charge.

cards.front: Lo que él quiere me importa poco.
cards.back: What he wants matters little to me.

cards.front: Esta decisión importa poco hoy, pero importará mucho en el futuro.
cards.back: This decision matters little today but it will matter greatly in the future.

cards.front: Lo único que importa es que estemos de acuerdo.
cards.back: The only thing that matters is that we agree.

cards.front: Lo único que importa es que estemos juntos.
cards.back: The only thing that matters is that we're together.

cards.front: Lo único que importa ahora es que tomemos la decisión correcta.
cards.back: The only thing that matters now is that we make the right decision.

cards.front: ¿Qué le pasaba a Kyle? Le vi llorando antes.
cards.back: What was the matter with Kyle? I saw him crying earlier.

cards.front: Jenny parecía estar de bajón. ¿Qué le pasaba?
cards.back: Jenny seemed a bit down. What was the matter with her?

cards.front: Phil parecía un poco callado antes. ¿Qué le pasaba?
cards.back: Phil seemed a bit quiet earlier. What was the matter with him?

cards.front: ¿Le pasaba algo a Frank? No era el mismo Frank de siempre.
cards.back: Was something the matter with Frank? He wasn't his usual self.

cards.front: Estabas diferente en la reunión de la semana pasada. ¿Qué te pasaba?
cards.back: You weren't your usual self in last week's meeting. Was something the matter?

cards.front: Carla parecía un poco deprimida antes. ¿Qué le pasaba?
cards.back: Carla seemed a bit down earlier. Was something the matter with her?

cards.front: ¿Qué le pasa a tu maleta? Parece que está coja.
cards.back: What's the matter with your suitcase? It looks wonky.

cards.front: ¿Qué le pasa al proyector? No funciona.
cards.back: What's the matter with the projector? It isn't working.

cards.front: Tu silla está un poco coja. ¿Qué le pasa?
cards.back: Your chair's a bit wonky. What's the matter with it?

cards.front: Algo le pasa al horno. No funciona bien.
cards.back: Something's wrong with the oven. It's not working properly.

cards.front: Algo le pasaba a mi portátil ayer. No funcionaba bien.
cards.back: Something was wrong with my laptop yesterday. It wasn't working properly.

cards.front: Mi móvil tampoco funcionaba esta mañana. Algo le pasa.
cards.back: My mobile wasn't working properly again this morning. Something's wrong with it.

cards.front: Le pasa algo a él. Ha estado raro últimamente.
cards.back: There's something wrong with him. He's been out of sorts lately.

cards.front: Shelley estuvo rara el sábado. Creo que le pasaba algo.
cards.back: Shelley was out of sorts on Saturday. I think there was something wrong with her.

cards.front: Estoy seguro de que antes le pasaba algo a Michael. Estaba raro.
cards.back: I'm sure there was something wrong with Michael earlier. He was out of sorts.

cards.front: ¿Te importaría dejar salir al perro?
cards.back: Would you mind letting the dog out?

cards.front: ¿Te importaría dejar entrar al gato?
cards.back: Would you mind letting the cat in?

cards.front: ¿Te importaría dejar entrar a Ryan?
cards.back: Would you mind letting Ryan in?

cards.front: ¿Te importaría cuidar de mi perra mientras estoy fuera?
cards.back: Would you mind looking after my dog while I'm away?

cards.front: Pregúntale a Olivia si le importaría dar de comer al gato mientras estamos fuera.
cards.back: Ask Olivia if she would mind feeding the cat while we're away.

cards.front: ¿Te importaría regar mis plantas mientras estoy fuera?
cards.back: Would you mind watering my plants while I'm away?

cards.front: No me importaría cuidar de tu perra.
cards.back: I wouldn't mind looking after your dog.

cards.front: Estoy seguro de que a ella no le importaría dar de comer al gato mientras estamos fuera.
cards.back: I'm sure she wouldn't mind feeding the cat while we're away.

cards.front: A Carly no le importaría regar tus plantas mientras estás fuera.
cards.back: Carly wouldn't mind watering your plants while you're away.

cards.front: Me gustaría ver la nueva película de Clint Eastwood este fin de semana.
cards.back: I wouldn't mind seeing the new Clint Eastwood film this weekend.

cards.front: Me gustaría tomarme las cosas con calma este fin de semana.
cards.back: I wouldn't mind taking it easy this weekend.

cards.front: Kirsty dijo que le gustaría quedar después del trabajo.
cards.back: Kirsty said she wouldn't mind meeting up after work.

cards.front: Me vendría bien una copa de vino.
cards.back: I wouldn't mind a glass of wine.

cards.front: Me vendría bien un descansillo.
cards.back: I wouldn't mind a quick break.

cards.front: Me vendría bien un paseo a lo largo de la playa.
cards.back: I wouldn't mind a walk on the beach.

cards.front: Tenga cuidado para no introducir el pie entre coche y andén.
cards.back: Mind the gap!

cards.front: Cuidado con el hueco cuando se abran las puertas.
cards.back: Mind the gap when the doors open.

cards.front: Cuidado con el hueco cuando subas al tren.
cards.back: Mind the gap when you're getting on the train.

cards.front: ¡Cuidado con la cabeza!
cards.back: Mind your head!

cards.front: El techo queda muy bajo aquí, ¡así que cuidado con la cabeza!
cards.back: The ceiling is very low here so mind your head!

cards.front: Dile a él que tenga cuidado con la cabeza. El techo queda más bajo aquí.
cards.back: Tell him to mind his head. The ceiling is lower here.

cards.front: ¡Cuidado con el bolso! Este sitio está lleno de carteristas.
cards.back: Mind your handbag! This place is full of pickpockets.

cards.front: Cuidado con el bolso cuando subas al tren.
cards.back: Mind your handbag when you're getting on the train.

cards.front: Ojo con los carteristas y cuidado con tu bolso.
cards.back: Watch out for pickpockets and mind your handbag.

cards.front: ¡Cuidado con el escalón!
cards.back: Mind the step!

cards.front: Cuidado con el escalón cuando bajes del autobús.
cards.back: Mind the step when you're getting off the bus.

cards.front: Cuidado con el escalón. No querrás tropezar.
cards.back: Mind the step. You don't want to trip over.

cards.front: ¿Qué has dicho? ¡Vigila tus modales!
cards.back: What did you say? Mind your manners!

cards.front: La señora Burns es bastante correcta, así que vigila tus modales.
cards.back: Mrs. Burns is rather posh, so mind your manners.

cards.front: Por favor, vigila tus modales en la casa de la señora Colbert. Es bastante correcta.
cards.back: Please mind your manners in Mrs. Colbert's house. She's rather posh.

cards.front: Éste es un asunto muy delicado, así que ten cuidado con lo que dices.
cards.back: This is a very delicate matter so be careful what you say.

cards.front: ¿Sabes si esto es un asunto delicado?
cards.back: Do you know if this is a delicate matter?

cards.front: John dice que está aquí para hablar contigo sobre un asunto muy importante.
cards.back: John says he's here to talk to you about a very important matter.

cards.front: Los derechos de los votantes son un asunto importante desde hace décadas.
cards.back: Voter rights have been a big issue for decades.

cards.front: El sueldo es un asunto importante en esta empresa desde que empezó.
cards.back: Pay has been a big issue in this company since it started.

cards.front: El gobierno debería centrarse en los asuntos que afectan al hombre común.
cards.back: The government should focus on issues that affect the common man.

cards.front: ¿Sabes cuál es el tema de la reunión?
cards.back: Do you know what the subject of the meeting is?

cards.front: ¿Los agujeros negros? No sé mucho sobre ese tema.
cards.back: Black holes? I'm not very familiar with that subject.

cards.front: Es un tema que le resulta muy familiar a ella; estudió economía.
cards.back: It's a very familiar subject to her; she studied economics.

cards.front: El tema de mi presentación son los agujeros negros.
cards.back: The topic of my presentation is black holes.

cards.front: El tema del debate de hoy es la pena de muerte.
cards.back: Today's topic of discussion is capital punishment.

cards.front: ¿Cuál es el tema del debate de mañana?
cards.back: What's the topic of tomorrow's discussion?

cards.front: Tenemos que tratar este asunto cuanto antes. (Usa «deal with».)
cards.back: We have to deal with this question as soon as possible.

cards.front: Es normal que se preocupen por esta cuestión.
cards.back: It's understandable that they're worried about this question.

cards.front: Tenemos que tratar esta cuestión cuanto antes. (Usa «address».)
cards.back: We have to address this question as soon as possible.

cards.front: ¡Decídete ya!
cards.back: Make your mind up already!

cards.front: ¿Se ha decidido él ya?
cards.back: Has he made up his mind yet?

cards.front: ¿Cuándo se va a decidir él?
cards.back: When's he going to make his mind up?

cards.front: Él ha vuelto a cambiar de idea, ¿verdad?
cards.back: He's changed his mind again, hasn't he?

cards.front: Diane va a volver a cambiar de idea, ¿verdad?
cards.back: Diane's going to change her mind again, isn't she?

cards.front: Lo siento, he cambiado de idea.
cards.back: I'm sorry, I've changed my mind.

cards.front: Sé que no soy el mismo de siempre. Perdona, tengo muchas cosas en la cabeza.
cards.back: I know I'm not my usual self. Sorry, I have a lot on my mind.

cards.front: Él no ha sido el mismo de siempre últimamente, pero está bien, es sólo que tiene muchas cosas en la cabeza.

cards.front: Quedé con Sarah ayer. Ella tiene muchas cosas en la cabeza.

cards.front: Ella ha estado pensando mucho en su exmarido últimamente.
cards.back: Her ex-husband has been on her mind lately.

cards.front: He estado pensando mucho en volver a la universidad últimamente.
cards.back: Going back to university has been on my mind lately.

cards.front: Él ha estado pensando mucho en Diane.
cards.back: Diane's been on his mind.

cards.front: Pareces descontento. ¿Qué te preocupa?
cards.back: You look upset. What's on your mind?

cards.front: Pareces raro. ¿Qué te preocupa?
cards.back: You look out of sorts. What's on your mind?

cards.front: ¿Te pasa algo? Dime qué te preocupa.
cards.back: Are you going through something? Tell me what's on your mind.
